wage.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS)
wage.basis: Pre-tax hourly wage, all occupations, metropolitan statistical areas
wage.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, OEWS

rent.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 1-year estimates, table B25031
rent.basis: Median monthly gross rent (contract rent plus utilities), metropolitan statistical areas
rent.attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

gas.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update
gas.basis: Retail price of regular gasoline (all formulations), dollars per gallon, including taxes
gas.coverage_note: EIA publishes city prices for only 10 areas; EIA's city sampling areas may not match metro (CBSA) boundaries exactly. All other metros have no gas data.

owner.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 1-year estimates, tables B25077 and B25088
owner.basis: Median home value and median monthly owner costs for owners with a mortgage (owner costs include taxes, insurance, utilities, and fees), metropolitan statistical areas
owner.attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

measures.owner_cost_with_mortgage: Median monthly owner costs, with a mortgage

groceries.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Average Price Data (CPI)
groceries.basis: National (U.S. city average) retail prices; not metro values
groceries.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Average Price Data

grocery_estimates.source: Estimates from U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Average Price Data and U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis Regional Price Parities
grocery_estimates.basis: Estimated metro prices: national BLS average price x BEA all-goods RPP / 100. Not observed metro prices.
grocery_estimates.attribution: Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Average Price Data; U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Price Parities
grocery_estimates.coverage_note: BEA publishes no Regional Price Parities for Puerto Rico metros; they have no estimate.

map.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 Gazetteer Files, core based statistical areas (internal points)

acs_home_value.description: Census ACS 1-year median value of owner-occupied housing units, for the metro

acs_owner_cost_with_mortgage.description: Census ACS 1-year median selected monthly owner costs for owner-occupied units with a mortgage, for the metro. Includes the mortgage payment plus real estate taxes, homeowner's insurance, utilities, and fees; not the mortgage payment alone

acs_rent_1br.description: Census ACS 1-year median monthly gross rent (rent plus utilities), 1 bedroom, for the metro

acs_rent_2br.description: Census ACS 1-year median monthly gross rent (rent plus utilities), 2 bedrooms, for the metro

acs_rent_all_units.description: Census ACS 1-year median monthly gross rent (rent plus utilities), all units, for the metro

bea_rpp_goods.description: BEA Regional Price Parity for all goods (U.S. = 100), for the metro

bls_ap_bananas.description: BLS Average Price Data, U.S. city average, bananas, per lb, not seasonally adjusted

bls_ap_bread.description: BLS Average Price Data, U.S. city average, bread, white pan, per lb, not seasonally adjusted

bls_ap_coffee.description: BLS Average Price Data, U.S. city average, coffee, 100% ground roast, per lb, not seasonally adjusted

bls_ap_eggs.description: BLS Average Price Data, U.S. city average, eggs, grade a large, per dozen, not seasonally adjusted

bls_ap_ground_beef.description: BLS Average Price Data, U.S. city average, ground beef, 100% beef, per lb, not seasonally adjusted

bls_ap_milk.description: BLS Average Price Data, U.S. city average, milk, whole, per gallon, not seasonally adjusted

eia_gas_14460.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Boston, MA (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_16980.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Chicago (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_17410.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Cleveland, OH (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_19740.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Denver (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_26420.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Houston (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_31080.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Los Angeles (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_33100.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Miami, FL (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_35620.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for New York City (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

eia_gas_42660.description: EIA monthly average retail price of regular gasoline for Seattle, WA (EIA city area mapped to this metro)

est_rpp_goods_bananas.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for bananas (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

est_rpp_goods_bread.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for bread, white pan (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

est_rpp_goods_coffee.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for coffee, 100% ground roast (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

est_rpp_goods_eggs.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for eggs, grade a large (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

est_rpp_goods_ground_beef.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for ground beef, 100% beef (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

est_rpp_goods_milk.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for milk, whole (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

oews_hourly_median.description: BLS OEWS median hourly wage, all occupations, for the metro
